sleeves.title: Sleeves
sleeves.caption: Your sleeves
sleeves.intro: A sleeve is a bucket you group instruments into, such as US equity or gold. Give it a target share of your portfolio and a band to see how far you have drifted; leave both empty until you have decided.
sleeves.name: Name
sleeves.targetHint: Optional. For example 40 for 40% of the portfolio.
sleeves.bandHint: Optional. Drift inside the band counts as on target.
sleeves.membersHint: Tick the instruments that belong here. An instrument is in one sleeve at a time, so ticking one that is in another sleeve moves it.
sleeves.noInstruments: You have no instruments yet. Add one under Holdings.
sleeves.membersManaged: The active strategy {{name}} can also place instruments in its sleeves (its members list), and does so each time it is saved.
sleeves.over: The targets add up to {{total}}%, which is more than 100%.

empty.title: No sleeves yet
empty.body: Add a sleeve and tick the instruments that belong in it, or set a sleeve when you edit an instrument.

sleeves.managed: Targets and bands come from the active strategy {{name}}.
